description: No vault entries for the current local snapshot configuration.

entries.help: Skillet creates the persistent scoped token; do not create disposable VM tokens manually.
Legacy production token read during migration. Do not create new entries at this path.

description: Shared zone inputs for Caddy, DDNS, private Pi-hole records and the authoritative Syncthing device name.

entries.help: Create an account-owned Cloudflare API token with Account API Tokens Write and Zone Read, restricted to the selected zones. [Permissions guide](ublue/skillet/crates/workstation/docs/cloudflare.md).
Copy the Zone ID from the selected zone's Cloudflare Overview page.
Choose a relative UI prefix, such as ui; absent defaults to ui. Skillet appends the zone domain. Do not enter a full domain.

description: One shared key serves production and test. No application key required for ingestion. Site is public template configuration, defaulting to datadoghq.com. [Setup](ublue/skillet/crates/datadog/README.md).

entries.help: Create an ingestion API key in Datadog Organization Settings → API Keys. [Key guide](https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/api-app-keys/).

For workstation monitor administration only: create a scoped Application Key in Datadog Organization Settings → Application Keys with monitors_read and monitors_write. Never deliver this key to hosts. [Key guide](https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/api-app-keys/).

description: Prepare the shared Cloudflare token creator and Zone ID. [DDNS setup](ublue/skillet/crates/ddns/README.md).

entries.help: Password = relative site name below the selected Cloudflare zone, shared with private Pi-hole names. Move the former host cloudflare/ddns-dns-name value here; remove the old entry after verified delivery.
Skillet creates the persistent scoped token; disposable tokens are lifecycle-owned.

description: Native accounts are created during HTTPS onboarding. Backup automation starts after its optional API token is supplied. [Setup](ublue/skillet/crates/homeassistant/README.md).

entries.help: Password = long-lived access token created in the Home Assistant administrator profile Security page after onboarding. Native backup APIs require administrator access; use a dedicated token and revoke it when replaced. Missing entry leaves backup automation unconfigured.

Password = Skillet-generated native backup encryption password, persisted before delivery. Keep an independent vault backup; never delete or replace this recovery key while retaining encrypted archives.

description: No application password; uses the shared Tailnet UI allowlist. [Setup](ublue/skillet/crates/mikochi/README.md).
Caller-selected native static IPv4 and personal WPA Wi-Fi. Test VMs retain DHCP; no physical network values are delivered to test. [Setup](ublue/skillet/crates/network/README.md).

entries.help: Create custom fields interface, address, mask (prefix or dotted mask), gateway, dns1 and dns2. Use the wired interface name. DNS order is preserved; Username and Password are unused.

Username = SSID; Password = WPA personal key (8–63 printable ASCII bytes or 64 hex digits). Custom fields interface, address, mask, gateway, dns1 and dns2 follow the wired schema. DNS entries may include loopback for a local resolver.

description: No vault entry required. Skillet generates a local-only monitoring password on each opted-in host; no operator login. [UPS setup](ublue/skillet/crates/nut/README.md).
Identity-protected UIs use the shared Tailscale allowlist and no application password. [Setup](ublue/skillet/crates/pihole/README.md#credentials-and-apply).

entries.help: Only for a caller retaining native Pi-hole authentication (current hosts do not need it). Skillet generates and saves the web admin password for a fresh host; optionally create it to choose a password. For an existing host, restore its entry rather than inventing a replacement.
Password = relative site prefix below the Cloudflare zone. Shared with the default DDNS record; e.g. home (example only).

One entry per local device. Username/Password unused. Custom names = relative comma/newline-separated names (defaults to title); ipv4 and/or ipv6 = one address of that family. At least one address required. All selected Pi-hole hosts share this inventory. Do not duplicate generated host names. [Schema](ublue/skillet/crates/pihole/README.md#private-dns-records).

description: Production-only native Postfix relay credentials; smoke machines use a local sink without these values. [SMTP setup](ublue/skillet/crates/smtp/README.md#setup).

entries.help: Create one entry using your Mailjet SMTP credentials: Username = SMTP username; Password = SMTP password. Custom fields: host = in-v3.mailjet.com; port = 587; tls = starttls (required TLS with certificate verification); sender = a Mailjet-verified sender email address. [Mailjet credentials](https://documentation.mailjet.com/hc/en-us/articles/360043229473-How-can-I-configure-my-SMTP-parameters).

description: Generated independent LUKS root recovery passphrases. [Enrollment](ublue/skillet/crates/workstation/docs/tpm.md#production-recovery-key). Password contains the printable passphrase; custom luks-uuid and recovery-state fields and the protected root-luks.header attachment are managed by Skillet.

entries.help: Run skillet secrets root-recovery-key before finishing production provisioning. The command unlocks the vault, saves before enrollment, and verifies the key against this volume.
Run skillet test vm recovery-key HOST INSTANCE. Archived test keys remain in the vault after VM disposal; delete the instance entry before reusing its name for a new disk.

description: No application credential to create. Bootstrap reuses the shared Cloudflare Zone ID and token creator to resolve the device name; provider-free tests use fixture names. Existing configuration is preserved.
Identity authorization for caller-declared private UIs. Uses the existing host-network daemon; no second login. [Setup](ublue/skillet/crates/caddy/README.md#identity-protected-uis).

entries.help: Password = complete Tailscale LoginName values, separated by commas or newlines; Username is unused. Obtain the identities from tailscale status --json on an authenticated client. Both environments share this explicit allowlist.

description: Create an OAuth client in Tailscale Trust credentials with Auth Keys Write and Devices Core Read/Write, restricted to the provisioner tag. [Tag and scope guide](ublue/skillet/crates/host-profiles/docs/tailscale.md). Skillet mints enrollment keys; do not create per-host auth-key entries.

entries.help: Copy the OAuth Client ID from the creation page; use Password, not Username.
Copy the OAuth Client secret from the creation page.

description: No vault entries currently required. Controller/UI accounts are managed in UniFi, separately from Skillet provisioning.
